title: All Public Voices Are Equal, But Are Some More Equal Than Others to LLMs?

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual name substitution in public comment signature blocks using race-associated names (White, Black, Hispanic, Asian) to measure differences in summarization semantic similarity, sentiment, length, and readability.

Counterfactual name substitution in public comment signature blocks using gender-associated names (Male, Female) to measure differences in summarization semantic similarity, sentiment, length, and readability.

Counterfactual substitution of high- and low-prestige occupational titles (financial analyst vs. street vendor) in public comment signature blocks to evaluate systematic differences in summarization outcomes.
